يحتمون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَمُونَ (yaḥtamūna) /jaħ.ta.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
# يُحْتَمَوْنَ (yuḥtamawna) /juħ.ta.maw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
